name: Lohuecotitan
sum: Lohuecotitan is a titanosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Lo Hueco, Cuenca, Spain, named in 2016.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: HUE-EC-01, a disarticulated partial skeleton with cervical, dorsal, sacral and caudal vertebrae, ribs, ulna, ischia, pubis, femur, fibula and tibia.
material: Teeth and braincases were also recovered at the site, from at least two kinds of titanosaur.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Díez Díaz et al. 2016

sources.text: Díez Díaz, V.; Mocho, P.; Páramo, A.; Escaso, F.; Marcos-Fernández, F.; Sanz, J.L.; Ortega, F. 2016. A new titanosaur (Dinosauria, Sauropoda) from the Upper Cretaceous of Lo Hueco (Cuenca, Spain). Cretaceous Research 68: 49–60. doi:10.1016/j.cretres.2016.08.001
